subtitle: 투력·은신 허리띠 구경하다 1넴 천장에 단체 압사

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
오 대박! 놈리건 1넴이
투력에 은신 증가 달린
가죽 허리띠를 줬어!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle three-quarter over-the-shoulder view looking past the back of the Orc Warrior tank (right, wielding a one-handed sword and sturdy kite shield, glancing back) toward the Gnome Rogue (left, daggers cleanly sheathed at her waist) holding up a glowing brown leather belt with a gleaming silver buckle in both hands with thrilled sparkling eyes. Minimal pale gray dungeon dust and a tiny defeated mechanical boss scrap silhouette at their feet.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
헐, 옵션 진짜 미쳤다!
야드랑 도적 둘 다
눈 돌아갈 만하네…!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dramatic low-angle close-up shot looking up from the glowing brown leather belt held in the foreground toward the Tauren Druid (left, gnarled wooden staff strapped neatly across her back, leaning in excitedly with huge starry eyes and clasped hands) and the Gnome Rogue (right, side profile, peering greedily at the belt with daggers sheathed). Minimal comic sparkle lines around the belt.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
야, 템 그만 구경해!
놈리건 천장 무너진다!
당장 튀어— 으악!!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Extreme low-angle Dutch-tilt action shot looking sharply upward as massive jagged grey dungeon boulders and dust streaks plummet from above. On the left, the Orc Warrior tank braces in panic with her one-handed axe and raised kite shield overhead, shouting desperately; on the right, the distracted Gnome Rogue (daggers sheathed) finally whips her head upward in mid-gasp while still clutching the leather belt.

3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle wide back-view over-the-shoulder slapstick freeze-frame: the Night Elf Priest stands frozen in the left foreground holding her golden Holy Cross staff inside a fading translucent golden protective bubble, staring stiffly in deadpan shock at a huge comical mound of grey boulders on the right where small leather boots, a green leather-booted foot, and cute Tauren hooves stick helplessly out from under the rocks with swirling comic dust puffs.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
어… 다들 허리띠 보다가
진짜 돌무더기에
깔려 죽으신 거예요…?
cuts.visual_prompt: 3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Side-profile over-the-shoulder close-up: the Night Elf Priest on the left leans forward slightly with dark exhausted deadpan eyes and her golden Holy Cross staff tucked under her arm, staring down at the right where the Tauren Druid's cute little head and ears peek flatly out from beneath a heavy grey boulder with tiny spinning dizzy stars.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
무덤 이동 누르지 마세요.
영혼의 치유사 보러 가지 말고
일단 한 분씩 부활 넣을게요…
cuts.visual_prompt: 3 to 3.5-head-proportion sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic high-angle diagonal aftermath shot: on the left, the weary Night Elf Priest raises her golden Holy Cross staff with both hands to channel warm golden-white resurrection sparkles toward the rubble mound on the right, where a tiny translucent ghostly Gnome Rogue (daggers sheathed, still clinging to a ghostly leather belt) floats dizzyingly above her crushed self, halting mid-reach.
